in_marathi.name: Balirvijay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Power of Bali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balirvijay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balirvijay is a name derived from Sanskrit. The name 'Balirvijay' is a combination of two words: 'Bali' and 'Rvijay'. 'Bali' refers to the ancient king of the Asura tribe in Hindu mythology, known for his immense strength and courage. 'Rvijay' means 'victory'. Therefore, Balirvijay is a name that signifies the power and victory of Bali.
